title: Account Manager, Renewals & Expansion (West Coast)
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

We’re hiring a results-driven account manager to own and accelerate the adoption, retention and growth of our customers. As a critical member of our post-sale team, you will be the primary commercial point of contact for a key segment of our customers. You will act as a trusted commercial advisor, focused on building lasting partnerships, ensuring customers realize the full value of LangChain, and driving usage, renewal and expansion of their investment. Your success will be directly measured by your impact on customer retention and net revenue retention.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage the entire customer lifecycle post signature for a portfolio of commercial customers, from adoption to contract execution, ensuring high retention rates.

- Develop and maintain a rolling forecast of your portfolio and consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual renewal and net retention targets.

- Proactively identify and mitigate churn risk by understanding customer health, monitoring product usage, and addressing commercial obstacles.

- Uncover and execute on expansion opportunities by understanding customer needs, aligning them with new features and products, and articulating the incremental value.

- Build and nurture lasting relationships with key stakeholders, from technical users to economic buyers.

- Act as the voice of the customer, synthesizing feedback on value, product gaps, and business outcomes to inform the product roadmap and collaborate with Product and Engineering teams.

- Partner closely with Sales, GTM Engineering, and RevOps teams to present a unified post-sale experience and ensure a seamless customer journey.

- Lead commercial negotiations, structure renewal contracts, and manage quoting and procurement processes to ensure favorable terms for both the customer and LangChain.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years of experience in a quota-carrying, customer-facing role such as Account Management, Customer Success, or Renewals Manager, preferably within B2B SaaS.

- A proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding retention and expansion quotas (e.g., Gross Renewal Rate, Net Revenue Retention).

- Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, with experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder renewal cycles.

- Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand and articulate the value of complex technical products. Familiarity with the modern AI/LLM stack is a significant plus.

- Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build rapport and convey value to diverse audiences, from technical users to executive decision-makers.

- A deep empathy for the customer's business objectives

Build CI/CD pipelines and API-driven integrations across Intune, Entra ID, Freshservice, AWS, and Juniper, and deliver reusable automation modules other engineers can build on. Convert high-volume manual processes into automated Freshservice service catalog workflows.

Senior Azure Architect - MIM Modernization & Microsoft Entra ID

Industry: IT Services

Salary: ₹₹24 LPA

Experience: 10+ years

Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Azure Architect to lead the strategic modernization of our Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM) infrastructure and drive the adoption of Microsoft Entra ID. In this pivotal role, you will design and implement robust, scalable identity solutions that enhance security and operational efficiency across our cloud ecosystem. This position demands a deep understanding of hybrid identity environments, where you will bridge legacy systems with modern cloud-native architectures. Your expertise will be instrumental in orchestrating complex migrations, automating identity workflows, and ensuring seamless integration between on-premises directories and cloud services, ultimately securing our digital perimeter while enabling a frictionless user experience.

Responsibilities

• Architect and execute the modernization roadmap for Microsoft Identity Manager, transitioning from legacy on-premises models to cloud-centric identity frameworks.

• Design and deploy secure identity synchronization solutions utilizing Entra Connect and Entra Cloud Sync to maintain data consistency across hybrid environments.

• Develop and manage serverless automation workflows using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Automation to streamline identity lifecycle processes.

• Engineer custom integrations and extensions leveraging Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and JSON protocols to enable advanced application connectivity.

• Maintain and optimize hybrid directory services, including Active Directory, AD LDS, and Exchange Online, ensuring high availability and performance.

• Implement robust security postures by configuring Azure Key Vault for secret management and utilizing Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel for proactive threat detection and response.

• Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives using Bicep, ARM templates, and Terraform to ensure reproducible, version-controlled infrastructure deployments.

• Create and maintain complex PowerShell scripts for Entra ID administration, enabling sophisticated automation and governance capabilities.

• Provide architectural guidance on Azure infrastructure design to support identity and access management (IAM) requirements.

Requirements

Requirements:

• Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in IT services, with a significant focus on Azure cloud architecture and identity management.

• Proven expertise in Microsoft Entra Connect and Entra Cloud Sync configuration and troubleshooting.

• Advanced proficiency in developing and managing Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Automation runbooks.

• Strong command of Microsoft Graph API, RESTful web services, and JSON data handling for custom integrations.

• Deep knowledge of Active Directory ecosystems, including AD LDS and Exchange Online administration.

• Hands-on experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft Sentinel for security and observability.

• Demonstrated ability to implement Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM, or Terraform.

• Specialized experience in Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM), including scripting, customization, and modernization strategies.

• Extensive background in PowerShell scripting specifically for Microsoft Entra ID automation and management.

• Comprehensive understanding of Azure Architecture principles and best practices for enterprise-scale deployments.

This is a consultative, relationship-driven B2B sales role: you will identify the right institutions, understand what their faculty and deans actually need, show how AMBOSS can address it, and guide each partnership from first conversation to signed agreement and successful launch.

For this opportunity, you are required to be a licensed medical doctor in a Latin American country, and while having previous commercial or sales experience is a plus, the personality and attitude comes first.

- Represent AMBOSS. Plan campus events and projects, attend conferences, and actively network to build brand awareness in the region.

WHAT YOU BRING:

- You are a licensed medical doctor from a Latin American country

NICE-TO-HAVE

description:
Райффайзен Банк - найбільший український банк з іноземним капіталом. Більше 30 років ми створюємо та вибудовуємо банківську систему нашої держави.
У Райфі працює понад 5 тисяч співробітників, серед них одна із найбільших продуктових ІТ-команд, що налічує 900+ фахівців. Щодня пліч-о-пліч ми працюємо, щоб більш ніж 2,5 мільйона наших клієнтів могли отримати якісне обслуговування, користуватися продуктами і сервісами банку, розвивати бізнес, адже ми #Разом_з_Україною. 

Твої майбутні обов’язки: 

• Здійснювати продаж банківських продуктів існуючим та новим клієнтам банку
Твій досвід та навич ки: 

• Вільно володієш українською мовою

• Маєш навички роботи з комп’ютером

• Маєш додаткові засоби живлення та стабільний інтернет під час відключення світла

• Готовий до роботи у напрямку телефонних продажів

• Швидко навчаєшся та легко сприймаєш великий обсяг інформації

• Легко знаходиш спільну мову з різними людьми

• Вмієш ефективно працювати в команді

• Можеш просто пояснювати складні речі

Пропонуємо те, що має значення саме для тебе: 

•
Конкурентна заробітна плата : гарантуємо стабільний дохід. Додатково, у нас діє реферальна програма винагороди за залучення нових колег до Райффайзен Банку.

•
Соціальний пакет: офіційне працевлаштування, 28 днів оплачуваної відпустки, додатковий «декрет» для татусів, та матеріальна допомога для батьків при народженні дітей.

•
Комфортні умови праці: гібридний формат роботи у м. Івано-Франківськ або віддалений формат роботи з можливістю працювати з будь якого куточка України, забезпечення сучасною технікою.
(засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)

•
Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.

•
Навчання та розвиток: повний супровід на старті (онбординг); тренерський центр для розвитку навичок; доступ до понад 130 навчальних онлайн-ресурсів; програма менторства; онлайн-бібліотека.

•
Крута команда: наші колеги - це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.

•
Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.

•
Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. Ми працюємо над підвищенням обізнаності керівників та команд з питань повернення ветеранів до цивільного життя. Райффайзен Банк відзначений як один з найкращих роботодавців для ветеранів (Forbes).

Чому Райффайзен Банк?  Наша головна цінність - люди і ми даємо їм підтримку і визнання, навчаємо, залучаємо до змін. Приєднуйся до команди Райфу, адже для нас ТИ маєш значення! 

• Один із найбільших кредиторів економіки та аграрного бізнесу серед приватних банків 

• Визнаний найкращим працедавцем за версіями EY, Forbes, Robota.ua, Stud-Point, Delo.UA, NV, Odgers, UAFIC

• Найбільший донор гуманітарної допомоги серед банків (Червоний Хрест України, UNITED24, Superhumans, СМІЛИВІ) 

• Одна з найбільших ІТ-продуктових команд серед банків країни 

• Один із найбільших платників податків в Україні, за 2025 рік було нараховано 6 млрд гривень

Можливості для всіх:

• Райф керується принципами, що фокусуються на людині та її розвитку, у центрі уваги понад 5 тисяч співробітників та 2,5 мільйона клієнтів  

• Підтримуємо принципи різноманіття, рівності та інклюзивності.

• Ми відкриті до найму ветеранів і людей з інвалідністю та готові адаптувати робоче середовище під ваші особливі потреби

• Співпрацюємо зі студентами та людьми старшого віку, створюючи умови для зростання на будь-якому етапі кар’єри.

В Райфі ти маєш значення!

description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

THE ROLE

You'll lead marketing operations and analytics at Cohere. That covers the team, the martech stack, how we measure marketing's contribution to pipeline, and the budget and pipeline numbers marketing plans against. When leadership asks what marketing produced last quarter and what to fund next, the answer starts with your numbers.

The role reports to the VP of Brand. You'll work most closely with the Marketing Chief of Staff and the heads of Growth and Demand and Product Marketing, and every week with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations & Finance. Web operations is part of marketing but doesn't report to this role.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

THE TEAM

You'll manage the marketing operations, automation, and analytics and data operations staff, and hire where you find gaps. Marketing is growing rapidly, so you'll also bring acquired companies' systems and data into our stack.

MEASUREMENT

The attribution methodology is yours, documented and signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. Each quarter you'll present marketing's pipeline contribution to the executive team and say what you'd change. Your analysts do the same for the program teams in Growth and Demand, Events and Product Marketing, showing which campaigns and channels are paying back their spend.

SYSTEMS AND DATA

Marketo, Looker, GA4 and 6sense are yours end to end, along with the campaign and lead side of Salesforce. That includes forms, nurture, lead lifecycle, scoring and routing. Campaign data needs to be structured well enough that analysts don't need workarounds, and target-account data has to reconcile to the governed account list. With Revenue Operations, you'll make sure the data behind marketing's pipeline numbers can't change without a record, so a bulk edit can't quietly rewrite marketing's results. A/B testing on nurture and forms sits with you too, sized so the results can be read.

Over time we want fewer tools and fewer dashboards, with one governed source for each metric.

BUDGET AND PLANNING NUMBERS

You'll own the martech and operations budget and track budget and headcount across marketing. You'll also build the pipeline and capacity models marketing plans against. The Marketing Chief of Staff runs planning and the business reviews and leads the trade-off conversations with your numbers in hand. Marketing and Sales need to count pipeline the same way, every time.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

In the first 90 days, you'll document the attribution methodology and get it signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. By then we should also have an inventory of every reporting surface, each with a named owner, and your order for fixing the data problems you inherit.

By three months, one governed executive dashboard has replaced the competing decks in business reviews, and rebuilt lead routing is in production.

By six months, target-account reporting reconciles to the governed list, and anyone on the team can reproduce quarterly attribution from the documented method, with change control on the data underneath it. The stack is smaller than when you arrived, and some marketing workflows run on age

description:
Application close date:
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed. At Blue Origin , we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 
Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations. As a Senior Modem SOC Design Engineer on the ASIC Engineering SOC Team, you will design digital hardware for the TeraWave satellite communication System on Chip (SOC). You will own RTL design for modem datapath and PHY blocks, implement signal processing hardware, and build out the Arm compute subsystem, debug, and IO infrastructure that surround it. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will work from communication system specifications through microarchitecture, RTL, SOC integration, and timing closure, partnering with architecture, verification, and physical design teams to deliver production silicon.

Responsibilities

• Design RTL in Verilog or System Verilog for modem datapath and PHY blocks

• Define microarchitecture from satellite communication system specifications and performance requirements

• Implement signal processing hardware including filters, FFT, equalizers, and forward error correction

• Develop Arm compute subsystem logic including AXI interconnect and SRAM controller integration

• Integrate debug subsystem components using Arm CoreSight architecture and associated trace infrastructure

• Design general purpose IO subsystem logic and associated configuration register interfaces

• Integrate subsystem and SOC level blocks including clock and reset architecture

• Support synthesis, timing constraint development, and timing closure with physical design teams

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field

• Minimum 5 years of experience in digital ASIC or SOC RTL design

• Experience with RTL design in Verilog or System Verilog for modem or PHY blocks

• Experience with Arm compute subsystem design including AXI interconnect and SRAM controllers

• Experience implementing signal processing hardware such as filters, FFT, or forward error correction

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field

• Experience with debug subsystem design using Arm CoreSight components

• Experience defining microarchitecture from communication system and algorithm specifications

• Experience with SOC level integration including bus fabric, clock, and reset architecture

• Experience with synthesis, timing constraint development, and timing closure support

• Experience with LPDDR6 or other high speed memory interface subsystems

• Experience with gigabit Ethernet or 25G high speed serial interface subsystems

title: Managing Director
description:
Are you ready to lead the Japan expansion of a trailblazing US-founded adtech company? Our client, a globally recognized video advertising platform with an established presence across Asia, is now looking for an ambitious, visionary Managing Director to drive its entry into the Japanese market.
In this go-to-market role, youll be at the helm of strategy and growth, leading the charge to establish and scale the business in Japan.
Your Mission:

•
Market Entry & Business Building: Spearhead our clients entry into the Japanese market, establishing a strong foundation for sustainable growth and brand presence.

•
Strategic Vision: Craft and execute a commercial strategy that resonates with Japanese agencies and brands, positioning the platform as a go-to solution for video advertising.

•
Team Leadership: Build and lead a high-performance team, cultivating a culture of excellence and innovation as you drive our clients success in Japan.

•
Client Relationships: Leverage your network to open doors and develop lasting partnerships with key agencies and brand advertisers in Japan.

What You Bring:

Proven Leadership in AdTech Significant experience leading commercial strategies in the adtech, martech, or digital media space, with a focus on Japan.

•
Go-To-Market Expertise A track record of building and scaling successful market entries in Japan, ideally within a fast-growing or startup environment.

•
Strong Industry Network Deep connections with agencies and brands in Japan, with the ability to open doors and influence at senior levels.

description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Own the frontend work for the Scale team, taking responsibility for the design, implementation, and ongoing quality of user-facing experiences across our platform products. You'll work independently on ambiguous problems, partnering with backend engineers, Product, Design, and other stakeholders to turn customer and business requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions.

- Build and maintain frontend experiences across the stack, with particular ownership and depth in React-based development

- Deliver reliable, maintainable solutions for multi-tenant platforms, enterprise integrations, and cross-domain product features

- Partner with backend engineers, Product, Design, and other stakeholders to turn customer and business requirements into effective technical solutions

- Make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, balancing flexibility, simplicity, and maintainability in system and component design

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

ESSENTIALS

- Strong experience building frontend applications with ReactJS.

- Experience with modern JavaScript or TypeScript.

- Experience working across the full stack, with the ability to own frontend work end to end.

- A track record of working independently and delivering high-quality software with minimal oversight.

- The ability to make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous situations.

- Clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Make pragmatic decisions on when to optimize for performance vs. velocity based on business impact

- Thrive in cross-functional environments spanning Product, Design, Compliance, and Sales

- Design for scale, maintainability, and production excellence

 

PREFERRED

- Fintech, payments, or regulated industry experience.

- High-scale performance tuning (100k+ QPS, large user bases, strict latency SLAs).

- Multi-tenant SaaS or platform architecture background.

- Proficiency with PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).

- Experience with OAuth2.0, API design, or developer documentation.

- Cross-region deployment or data residency compliance experience.

- Solutions engineering or customer-facing technical experience.

 

LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

The Scale team builds the infrastructure that lets platforms embed Airwallex financial products at speed and with confidence. The team owns multi-tenant systems powering companies like Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, and SHEIN. The engineering challenges are real: balancing tenant isolation with resource efficiency, low-latency performance with cross-data-center resilience, and immediate customer needs with long-term architectural extensibility. Beyond infrastructure, the team owns cross-domain product features and designs enterprise integrations by translating customer business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

description:
Role Title: Federal HR Specialist (Employee & Labor Relations)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Federal HR Specialist (Employee & Labor Relations) experts to support an innovative AI evaluation project for a government-focused customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Develop and articulate realistic federal HR scenarios and case studies grounded in Employee & Labor Relations, drawing from practical experience.

• Craft detailed reference answers and rationales based on federal HR policy and best practices.

• Review, assess, and provide constructive written feedback on material submitted by fellow subject-matter experts.

• Ensure project deliverables accurately reflect the nuances of federal HR decision-making, especially in Employee & Labor Relations contexts.

• Collaborate with project coordinators to resolve ambiguities or identify areas needing additional depth or clarity.

• Maintain clarity and precision by documenting the reasoning behind recommendations and scenario responses.

• Adhere to defined project guidelines, milestone requirements, and quality standards for all deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

• Current or former federal HR experience at the GS-0201 or GS-0260 series, or equivalent level in government service.

• Extensive, practical knowledge of Title 5 HR matters, including employee relations, labor relations, classification, or workforce restructuring.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly and concisely.

• Direct hands-on experience managing or advising on adverse actions, grievances, or appeals within a federal context.

• Background in position classification, rating and ranking, or experience with reduction in force processes.

• Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in scenario development and feedback.

• Based in the United States, familiar with current federal HR policies and procedures.

title: Investments Operations Senior Specialist - Backoffice
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

SOBRE A VAGA:

Estamos elevando a régua do nosso Backoffice Financeiro. Hoje o time garante conciliações, liquidações e atendimento regulatório com excelência - mas ainda de forma majoritariamente manual. Buscamos um Senior Specialist que una domínio das rotinas de backoffice de corretora com capacidade real de construir automações, para transformar processos manuais em fluxos automatizados, monitorados e escaláveis.

É uma posição para quem percebe o gargalo, desenha a solução, conversa com times de engenharia e coloca a mão na massa.

Você será responsável por:

- Conciliações financeiras de contas internas em parceria com Controllership, incluindo a evolução para conciliação entre custódia e financeiro.

- Automatizar rotinas manuais, construindo soluções com alertas e monitoramento - automação com governança, não apenas script rodando.

- Conduzir o fluxo de processos judiciais (bloqueio judicial, transferência de ativos para liquidação) e o processo de BDRO.

- Atendimento a órgãos reguladores e demandas regulatórias, com autonomia para responder e validar posicionamentos.

- Participar do processo de liquidação e das movimentações financeiras dos clientes da corretora, garantindo reflexo correto nos sistemas.

- Atuar como ponte entre backoffice e engenharia, traduzindo regra de negócio em requisito técnico, participando de fóruns de produto e antecipando impactos operacionais.

- Definir estratégia junto à liderança e orientar tecnicamente o time, elevando o nível de autonomia e conhecimento da área.

- Trabalhar em ações para melhoria e automatização de processos (Utilizando AI, Python dentre outras tecnologias) e rotinas na área, visando a automatização das rotinas, em alinhamento com a necessidade regulatória;

PROCURAMOS POR UMA PESSOA QUE:

- Certificação PQO B3 Backoffice - pré-requisito inegociável por exigência regulatória.

- Conhecimento intermediário em programação e análise de dados (Python, VBA, SQL, Power BI) - capacidade comprovada de escrever e manter automações.

- Conhecimento em Sinacor, com domínio dos módulos de Tesouraria e Conta Corrente (não é necessário uso diário atual, mas é necessário conhecer).

- Conhecimento de mercado financeiro, sistemas de pagamento e reconciliação financeira.

- Excel avançado;

- Comunicação e ótimo stakeholder management - a posição exige transitar entre backoffice, engenharia, controladoria e liderança, e apresentar temas complexos com clareza.
